scope: Live interactive Nano adaptation; separate from the executive-stage qualification and its playback backups.
rush_note: Free Mode uses a three-workflow scheduler and the existing gateway admission; these timings are not executive-stage deadlines or a hardware benchmark.
presenter_transition: Positive transition and rewarming verified in source tests; live control rejected presenter overlap during Free Mode and Rush. Final executive-stage rehearsal remains a separate gate.

offline_inference.endpoints: Existing loopback language/image/speech lanes; no external inference destination.

resolved_findings: Cold image startup must release only the owned native language engines before CPU materialization/upload, then restore the measured model order. Launcher now matches the established recovery path.
Increase the free app-planning output budget to include native reasoning and the visible plan.
Translate ordinary hyphenated words such as 4-week; preserve uppercase product identifiers and ISO dates.
New conversation must stay empty on subsequent state polling.
Image export removes its creative backing copy so deleting a Free Mode output does not leave a duplicate.
limits: Atlas is a bounded fictional-account assistant, not the full Fury SQL analytics system.
Agent Factory builds frontend-only apps. Generic app acceptance is a browser smoke check; the generated default calculator separately passed three arithmetic cases and zero-cost handling.
Text/PPTX/DOCX/WAV/PNG outputs are drafts for review. Language quality across all 34 target choices was not exhaustively evaluated.
Video Studio and Action Trailer are excluded; no Nano video model is loaded.
Raw prompts, uploaded images, generated decks/audio/artwork, private job identities and browser screenshots remain outside the source distribution.
